description: This Java class implements an in-memory device connection service for managing last known gateways per device and tenant, including methods to set and retrieve gateway information, with configuration for maximum devices per tenant.

classes.name: MapBasedDeviceConnectionService
classes.description: A service class that manages device gateway data in memory, providing methods to set and get last known gateways for devices.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last known gateway for a specific device, respecting maximum device limits per tenant.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last known gateway information for a specific device.

methods.name: createLastKnownGatewayJson
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing the last known gateway with timestamp.

methods.name: setLastUpdateDate
methods.description: Updates the JSON object with the current timestamp as last update date.
